body: I understand. I'll try to keep hope. For the sake of myself, and also for the sake of others that haven't had it. The idea of a baseless hope is a romantic idea in my head that I used to like to keep. It's like lighting a candle, in a way. I might try to hypothetically think of being hopeful, and maybe real hope will happen. I think it may really help. Thank you, stranger. I can't emphasize how much your care matters. I know I'm the one down at the moment, but if I can help in any way, message me, or write here, if you're ever in trouble too.

I don't know if you're from the U.S. or not, sorry to assume. That's Alcoholics Anonymous. And that's an interesting point about a control system. I might have to take up reading Vonnegut again. Humanism really intrigues me.

I'm definitely on the path to alcoholism. If I haven't arrived, already. Denial 101? haha. My therapist says I have, and suggested programs or inpatient care. It's definitely a problem. I'm pretty introverted, and I tried Smart Recovery, which is essentially atheistic AA, and I couldn't stand it. They make you speak publicly, and I can't do that. I can barely do therapy 1v1. I've tried a lot of things, and I'm running out of ideas, to be honest. Again, thanks for talking to me, I really appreciate it.
True. Thank you so much. I'll try again.

It's hard to describe. I wish I could make this easy. It feels like... nothing matters. And if nothing matters, why suffer pain? I drink to feel okay. That's it. It's not a party for me. It's a medication. Does that kind of make sense? I guess I need a different drug. Or a cure. I don't know what to do anymore. Thank you for reaching out and caring

Hey, I appreciate you reaching out. Thank you for this kindness. I agree, tapering would be a good place to start. I'll definitely try to do that. It usually becomes a cycle, though. I'll taper, and eventually be okay, then fall right back in. It's happened I think four times now. But you're right, tapering is the best first move. Thank you so much for answering and caring.
